# Data Processing Terms (SYNTHETIC FIXTURE)

Last updated: 2026-09-01

## Use of customer data
We process customer data only to provide the service. We do not use customer data to train machine learning or AI models.

## Retention
Customer data is deleted within 30 days of account termination.

## Sub-processors
We notify customers at least 30 days before adding a new sub-processor.
